text:
Marta (PMM): quick thread  we need a compact battlecard + two short launch posts for next week's webinar. focus: competitive claims vs cloud AI endpoints and infra vendors, plus routing for benchmark requests. keep it audience-ready.
Ethan (Growth): want two headline variants to A/B: one benefit-forward, one tradeoff-forward. also short social lines.
Priya (Field): reps asked for three 10-word lines: latency, cost, migration. also a one-sentence rebuttal vs "use your cloud provider".
Jon (Bench): topline bench bullets (gated deck has full details): p95 ~130ms at sustained 1k RPS in our harness; batching + prefix caching yields ~3x token efficiency on multi-turn chat flows; fallback policy maintained throughput during node eviction test.
Zoe (Content): public phrasing = "customer-observed". battlecard/internal can include raw numbers and a gated prompt comparison slide.
Rae (Sales Ops): routing rule proposals:
- rule A (conservative): if company_size > 700 OR budget_est > 200k => AE, else SDR. tag leads that click "benchmark-slide" as bench_warm.
- rule B (intent-first): if attendee_watch_pct > 50% OR clicked_benchmark => AE. tag bench_hot.
Ethan (Growth): headline options:
A) "Stabilize latency and cut per-token spend: a practical playbook"
B) "Why managed endpoints don't solve tail latency"
Decision: run A in paid social, B in nurture emails. tag ad clicks opener=A.
Priya (Field): rep one-liners (10 words):
- Latency: "Ask for bench deck  one slide: p95 ~130ms under load."
- Cost: "Typical customers see ~2-4x token efficiency for chat after batching."
- Migration: "Same API, prompts port without infra rewrite."
Zoe (Content): quick rebuttals (short):
- "Why not just use cloud endpoints?" -> "Cloud endpoints don't provide deterministic routing, KV cache, or tail protection; we do."
- "Is owning the model enough?" -> "Serving/runtime decide latency and cost; ownership alone isn't sufficient."
Jon (Bench): deliverables: 2-slide benchmark summary + 1-slide anonymized prompt comparison (due 4201239650).
Zoe (Content): deliverables: 1-page internal battlecard with 6 rebuttals, 3 demo soundbites, and a public-safe blog paragraph (due 4201239800).
Rae (Sales Ops): deliverable: implement chosen routing rule (A or B), add SFDC tags and AE automation, and create a test cohort mapping (due 4201239900).
deploy-bot: assets uploaded s3://redwood-assets/marketing/webinar-420123/bench-2slide.pdf at 4201239700
Marta (PMM): decision: Ads=A, Emails=B, start with routing rule A for general audience and run rule B on a high-intent cohort. public copy stays "customer-observed"; field gets numbers + "ask for deck" CTA. check-ins in this thread every 6h. :rocket:
